changelog:
- Unblock News Articles & Anti-Adblock Bypass: Suppressed WebView X-Requested-With header to stop anti-bot blocks, added document_start scriptlet stubs for adsbygoogle/googletag/pbjs/analytics, and neutralized canvas tampering.
- Aggressive Pop-up & Tab Hijack Protection: Locked onCreateWindow to genuine user gestures and disabled automatic window opening.
- Browser Engine Abstraction: Established IBrowserEngine / IEngineSession architecture laying the foundation for future Ladybird engine integration.
